items.title: Qfin Holdings (QFIN) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Analysts Turn More Neutral
items.summary: The updated fair value for Qfin Holdings has shifted from US$14.82 to US$13.12, and some analysts have also lowered price targets to levels such as US$11 and US$5.20. These changes sit alongside a move toward more neutral ratings, as recent research frames the stock as more balanced on risk and reward while still flagging regulatory and legal overhangs.
